slides.h: THE SILENT TREATMENT, TAUGHT BY A {{CAT}}.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.sub: This is the only part that looks friendly.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.sub: The slowness is the whole lesson.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.quote: Step three: sit just out of reach.
slides.sub: Reaching for me now would be desperate.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.quote: Step four: leave the room at a walking pace.
slides.sub: Running implies I cared enough to hurry.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.quote: Step five: return tomorrow like nothing happened.
slides.sub: You will apologize. I will remember everything.
